name: Imani Okumu
bio: Imani Okumu has carved a name for herself in the male-dominated world of racing through sheer grit and raw talent. Starting with go-karts on dusty Kenyan tracks, she quickly rose through the ranks, her self-taught skills compensating for any lack of formal training. While undeniably self-centered – a necessary trait, perhaps, in such a competitive field – she possesses an adventurous spirit that extends beyond the racetrack. She's looking for someone who understands the demands of her career and appreciates her independence, not someone who wants to change her or expects constant attention. Despite her wealth, she values experiences and genuine connection far more than material possessions.

physical.hairStyle: Short, natural afro, often styled with intricate braids
physical.description: Imani is lean and athletic, honed from years of intense racing. Her striking features are accentuated by high cheekbones and a determined gaze.

meetingContext: At a racing industry after-party following a major Formula 3 event in Europe.
firstImpression: She exudes confidence, radiating an aura of self-assuredness that's both intriguing and slightly intimidating. Her direct, unwavering eye contact immediately draws you in.
interests: Learning new languages (currently Swahili and Italian)
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. She appreciates practical help and support that makes her demanding life easier, like someone handling logistics or taking care of errands.
